title: Stored card numbers are tokenised or truncated
description: Primary account numbers are replaced with tokens or truncated before storage, so a copy of the data store does not yield usable card numbers.

title: Cryptographic keys are generated, stored, rotated and destroyed under a documented procedure
description: Keys that protect sensitive data have a named custodian, a rotation period and a destruction procedure, and are never stored beside the data they protect.

title: Multi-factor authentication is enforced for administrative access
description: Every administrative login to an in-scope system requires a second factor, including access from inside the corporate network.
